protocol.timing_gain_coverage: Exact primary fixed production gain, lag and evaluation samples from frozen run; no fitting
protocol.mask: Original magnitude >= original peak * 10^(-60/20), shared by both models; -80 dB original-peak magnitude floor
protocol.stft: Stereo channel powers are not downmixed; periodic Hann, hop N/4, no padding or boundary extension
protocol.limitation: Original-only mask omits candidate-only artifacts. Retain legacy union metrics alongside it. Neither metric is a perceptual threshold.
protocol.old_results: Read-only; every legacy union count, mean, P95 and unmasked spectral convergence must reproduce before reporting
